output.reason: [ev-dd94d38ea856] describes a bugfix: the `pilot-agent istio-clean-iptables` command now removes the `ISTIO_OUTPUT` iptables chain. `istio-clean-iptables` is a subcommand, not a flag. It has no leading `--`, so the cli-flag family does not fit. The closest family is a runtime networking behaviour of pilot-agent, so I used protocol-behavior. The proposed before/after values paraphrase the note instead of quoting literals from it, so I left them out; they are optional for behavior-changed.

correction.statement: The pilot-agent istio-clean-iptables command now removes the ISTIO_OUTPUT iptables chain, which it previously left in place.
